impact: input.model is forwarded to the primary's review, but runAdjudicate calls judge.crossReview({ content, findings }) with no model, so the primary's cross-review adjudication silently runs on the config default instead of the caller's per-call override. Inconsistent model usage within a single deliberate-deep call. Fix: thread the (primary-only) model override into adjudicateDivergent/runAdjudicate for the primary judge.
resolution: Fixed in T-030. The caller's per-call model override is now forwarded to the PRIMARY provider's cross-review adjudication turn (via adjudicateDivergent(primaryModel) → runAdjudicate(model) → crossReview input); the secondary judge continues to resolve its own default, matching the review convention. Threaded through all four adjudication paths (deliberatePlan/Code × fresh/resume). Tests assert the primary judge receives the model and the secondary does not, for both code and plan.
title: Per-call model override not forwarded to the primary's adjudication turn
